env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^\[6 8 10 12\] \[6 8 10 12\] \[6 8 10 12\] \[6 8 10 12\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/simdoperand

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	a := [4]float64{1, 2, 3, 4}
	b := [4]float64{5, 6, 7, 8}
	pa, pb := &a, &b
	f := func() *[4]float64 { return pb }
	ch := make(chan [4]float64, 1)
	ch <- a
	fmt.Println(*pa+*pb, *(f())+*pa, <-ch+b, (*(f()))+(*pa))
}
